g.text: Not implemented. Option B: one facility table with a kind discriminator.
A flat middle. A project with
Why one table and not plants + pipelines.
A plant is bounded by coordinates; a pipeline by
tables would force every upward query into a
two-branch COALESCE and an XOR CHECK constraint -
the classic smell of a missing abstraction.
What they genuinely share is being a *commissioning
parent*. What differs is *spatial addressing*, which
is exactly what a per-kind jsonb column is for.
Same pattern this codebase already proved twice:
Plant 3D's own refinery example has 13 areas, so
skipping the level would break lossless import.
But an Iranian booster station with 12 subsystems
should not have to invent 12 areas.
Absence of structure must not be reported as an
error - same rule as closurePercent() returning
no punch, no handover - it is a design
